core_obligations: Construct the Laurent matrix realization and prove the proposed q-dependent images satisfy the central defining relations of Delta.
For every reduced modular-group word, prove its Laurent-matrix representative is noncentral using a nonvanishing top coefficient and incompatible determinant-imposed scalar degree.
Use equivariance and simultaneous centralizers of the specialized A/B matrices to pull faithfulness back to Delta without assuming the realization pi is injective.

proof_roadmap.step: Define order-three and order-two automorphisms using the alternative algebra presentation.
Define Acal/Bcal/Ccal and conjugating p/s, verify products and common centralizer.
Top lambda coefficient in every alternating word is a nonzero signed p-power/s1/p-power; centrality would force degree ell/2 while actual degree is ell.
Construct equivariant pi; a kernel element commutes with qAcal+q^-1Acal^-1 and scalar Acal+Acal^-1, hence with Acal and Bcal, forcing trivial conjugation and trivial group word.

difficulty_reason: The counted result still requires an explicit noncommutative algebra-to-Laurent-matrix construction and transfer of faithfulness through a homomorphism which is not assumed injective. The essential local proof controls every alternating free-product word by its top polynomial coefficient and compares that degree with the determinant of a hypothetical scalar word, then identifies simultaneous centralizers to recover Delta faithfulness. All these author steps are retained as core, rather than assumed as prerequisites. H2 is proposed on this full chain; no H3 inference from the algebra name or article status. The separate PBW theorem with one Diamond-Lemma ambiguity was read but not promoted as another H2 task.

compared.difference: The public primary describes a vector-space basis of the centre for q not a root of unity; it does not count faithful PSL2(Z) action.

An algebra homomorphism into U_q(sl2) tensor a three-variable Laurent ring is injective; the present result is injectivity of the modular group action on the universal Askey-Wilson algebra. Distinct maps, statements and proof obligations.
Change of basis in a pencil of quadrics transforms an associated endomorphism by a fractional linear expression; no faithfulness claim on the Askey-Wilson algebra.
